signature-in-wrong-domain: The signature declares the vote domain. A verifier must reject a signature whose domain does not match the context, even when it is cryptographically valid.
decision-without-bundle-hash: INV-009: a decision must name the exact policy version AND its bundle hash, or it cannot be replayed by an auditor.
cross-border-without-target: cross_border is true with no target jurisdiction, so the action cannot be audited against passport scope.
passport-required-but-absent: The action declares a passport is required but records neither its hash nor its status at decision time.
unsigned: INV-002: an action is never attributed by a string identifier alone.
malformed-commitment: Commitments must be in the sha256:<64 hex> wire form.
